result.rationale: The proposal is specific enough to authorize a bounded paid pilot now. It identifies a recognizable problem—lost product rationale and onboarding context—and proposes a two-week engagement using three to five approved sources, named participants, concrete deliverables, a tested handoff, and an explicit continue/revise/stop decision. Privacy, correction, provenance, access, consent, and human review are treated as operating requirements. The page also honestly distinguishes an early method from a proven platform or completed client implementation. The public correction trace supplies limited but relevant evidence that the candidate can trace sources, revise records, and propagate corrections across outputs.
strengths: A concrete first use case centered on one slipping decision trail rather than a company-wide system.
Deliverables directly support onboarding and decision memory: a start-here page, decision record, open-question list, source notes, access notes, and correction path.
Adoption is tested through observable teammate tasks: finding, tracing, correcting, and protecting information.
The source-custody model separates access, evidence, consent, and publication authority.
Clear exclusions reduce surveillance, indiscriminate-ingestion, and parallel-bureaucracy risks.
Success conditions and the continue/revise/stop gate make the engagement reversible and accountable.
Maturity boundaries are candid: this is an emerging practice, not demonstrated SaaS or claimed client adoption.
missingEvidence: A redacted example showing the complete set of pilot deliverables working together in a realistic team workflow.
Independent evidence from a prior team engagement demonstrating reduced onboarding time or context loss.
Details about how the method integrates with common repositories, meeting tools, and documentation systems without adding excessive maintenance.
Indicative pricing, sponsor time requirements, security handling, and post-sprint ownership expectations.
result.constructiveCritique: The page makes the proposed use unusually clear, but its architectural explanation is longer and better evidenced than its delivery record. A compact, redacted pilot packet—with before-and-after workflow, teammate test results, maintenance burden, and sponsor decision—would make the hiring case more concrete. Adding indicative engagement assumptions would also reduce uncertainty between interest and authorization.
result.validateNext: In kickoff, validate the method against one representative approved decision trail: establish a baseline, have a new or less-contextual teammate use the prototype to find the rationale, trace its source, identify open or protected material, and submit a correction, then measure usefulness and maintenance effort before authorizing any expansion.
